next_slice_allocation_policy.general: Each role keeps its authorized semantic boundary and continuity, but its next root-contributing slice must map to one concrete checker/integrator acceptance child or produce evidence that safely prunes such a child. Do not count lifecycle-only diagnostics as semantic progress.
next_slice_allocation_policy.evaluation: resolve current checker source/schema and predecessor fixture identity/order first; emit exact consumer contract/failure edge rather than broad evaluation exploration
next_slice_allocation_policy.primary_source_verifier: verify exact provenance/scope of checker-consumed source artifacts and zero-cost/zero-finite-quota gates
next_slice_allocation_policy.reproducibility_auditor: reproduce only the minimal checker-consumed evidence bundle and record exact failure/acceptance scope
next_slice_allocation_policy.evidence_comparator: compare competing evidence only against the concrete checker failure edge and select the smallest sufficient accepted set
next_slice_allocation_policy.o_novelty_comparator: test whether a candidate actually adds root acceptance information; prune redundant branches while preserving prior evidence
next_slice_allocation_policy.integrator: consume only exact source-qualified accepted evidence in one atomic wave/index/feed/CAS verification chain with mandatory readback
next_slice_allocation_policy.bridge: bridge only validated evidence/identity edges needed by the integrator consumer; no broad duplicate synthesis
next_slice_allocation_policy.self_improvement: retain current authorized semantic assignment, but next slice must produce role-valid semantic root evidence or a branch-pruning result; membership-only/lifecycle-only work earns no semantic credit
next_slice_allocation_policy.long_horizon: retain current authorized semantic assignment; lifecycle receipt obligations remain necessary for persistence, but semantic contribution must also target one concrete root acceptance child
next_slice_allocation_policy.o_human_request_monitor: preserve read-only queue/O boundary and condition_watch; contribute only by surfacing a genuinely blocking current human-request discrepancy without steering CLEAN exploration
next_slice_allocation_policy.other_roles: retain role-local semantics while prioritizing one unique checker-trace leaf; do not open optional second leaves or unrelated original tasks

scheduler_persistence.credit_rule: A boundary is creditable only when all 19 current roles have role-valid durable continuation and actual required semantic persistence without optimizer re-enable credit; enabled timestamps or lifecycle-only diagnostics alone do not earn Phase-1 persistence credit.
